version_note: v2 corrects only the reduced-curvature diagnostic block extraction (F_star B/C blocks of the joint Hessian); no solver, gate, seed, budget or scientific design changed. Attempt 1 (freeze commit fee620e) outputs are retained under revision_week/outputs/phase4_solver_refinement_v1_attempt1_fee620e; recorded in docs/ISSUES.md as I-PHASE4-001.
purpose: answer whether the raw physical objective itself can reach a high-quality stationary point
answer whether the current solver failed because it did not exploit the residual-sum-of-squares structure
if raw refinement is genuinely hard, answer whether a fixed-reference proximal objective yields repeatable stable analysis states without materially breaking the physical fit
not_this_phase: no new confirmation seeds before the solver reachability gate passes
no E2 locality, no E3 one-step, no SO-ADAPT resume
no claim that Route P success implies Route R success
no SO-vs-GN comparison, no parameter-error feedback into solver or alpha choice

centers.selection_rationale: fixed subset of previously failed fresh Phase-2 centers, two per problem, selected before any Phase-4 SO/GN comparison, not selected by SO performance
centers.phase3_outcome_context: routes A/B/C on these centers failed reachability in phase3_reachability_v1 (A: iteration_budget_exhausted with gradients 1e-6..1e-7; B/C: budget_exhausted); recorded as context only, never used to steer Phase 4

R.name: raw
R.note: residual definition, training points, weights and fixed physical parameters all from the historical payload; no reweighting

P.name: proximal
P.objective: L_gamma(theta; theta0, lambda0) = L(theta, lambda0) + gamma/2 * ||theta - theta0||^2
P.gamma_rule: gamma_i = alpha * lambda_max(J_theta(theta0)^T J_theta(theta0)) evaluated once at the archived theta0, fixed lambda0, before any Route P solve
P.gamma_frozen: alpha, lambda_max, gamma and hashes recorded in gamma_computation.json before solving; never recomputed or drifted afterwards
P.anchor_rule: theta0 is the archived network state and is never updated by the solve, curvature, HVP or perturbation branches

solver.staging: scipy 1.15.3 least_squares has no callback; each stage runs bounded max_nfev chunks with repository-side gate checks between chunks
solver.stopping_policy: only frozen protocol gates or recorded budgets; no silent retries, no mid-protocol tolerance changes
solver.lm_note: method='lm' is allowed as a development-attachment route only; it never replaces the TRF main route and never triggers a protocol edit

stages.note: one shared nfev pool of 24000 across all stages; a stage that exhausts the pool leaves later stages not_attempted and recorded as such

gates.normalized_gradient: ||grad_theta L_sum|| / (m * max(||theta||, 1)) where L_sum is the sum-of-squares objective of the route
gates.stability_floor: lambda_min(A_target) > max(curvature_floor=0.0, eigenvalue numerical error bound) with the bound taken from the project's numerical_mu margin (eigen residual + orthogonality + asymmetry + 32*d*eps scale)

curvature_stability.unresolved_if: 1e-10 polish state not reached within the stage budget
curvature_stability.k12: additional diagnostic only; never overrides a passed 1e-8 + stable-K10 state

gates.route_R_loss_anomaly: Route R raw total loss relative increase > 0.05 is an anomaly -> NUMERICAL_FAILURE

curvature_definition.K: joint (theta, lambda) Hessian of the route's analysis objective at the checkpoint state; analysis objective is raw L for Route R and proximal L_gamma with the frozen gamma_solve for Route P
curvature_definition.binding_metric: relative Frobenius and spectral changes between K10 and K8
secondary_non_binding: F_star reduced Schur curvature and its eigenvalues
eta_state and eta_E Newton-state displacement diagnostics

labels.RAW_LOCAL_MINIMUM: REFERENCE_CAPABLE and H_raw theta-block numerically SPD; the only label allowed for an 'original objective is a strict local minimum' claim

decision_precedence: NUMERICAL_FAILURE: non-finite residual/gradient/Hessian at any recorded state, or Route R raw loss anomaly
RESOURCE_LIMIT: binding 1e-8 gate not reached because nfev pool or task wall budget exhausted
STATIONARITY_FAIL: scipy terminated on its own frozen criteria while the binding gate remained unmet (gradient stagnation)
STABILITY_FAIL: gate reached but the route stability matrix is not resolvably positive
CURVATURE_STABILITY_UNRESOLVED: gate + stability ok but the 1e-10 polish state not reached
CURVATURE_UNSTABLE: K10 reached but relative curvature drift > 0.05
PHYSICAL_FIT_FAIL: gate + stability + curvature ok but a frozen physical-fit gate violated (Route P)
PASS: all binding checks passed; REFERENCE_CAPABLE label recorded, RAW_LOCAL_MINIMUM if additionally raw-SPD

resources.scheduler_note: concurrency is an upper bound; if host memory cannot hold 6x4GiB the scheduler lowers concurrency, never the per-task limit

scipy_env_policy: record python/numpy/scipy/torch/BLAS versions before the first numerical task; do not upgrade scipy mid-phase; if missing, install and lock, and keep installation outside timed solve sections
scipy_success_not_binding: scipy_success != scientific_binding_valid; scipy only returns a candidate state and the repository's own diagnostics decide usability
diagnostics_saved: raw total loss (sum) before/after and mean
PDE / data / initial / boundary training-block residual norms (weighted blocks as defined by the payload)
state/output RMSE only if present in the payload
normalized gradient (route objective), raw gradient norm and proximal gradient norm separately for Route P
lambda_min_H_raw, lambda_min_A_fd, lambda_min_H_prox (Route P) and numerical floors
eta_state, eta_E, theta_displacement, relative_theta_displacement, proximal_term (diagnostics only, never promoted to gates after seeing results)

alpha_grid.status: deferred; may start only after the 12 minimal contrast tasks complete and per Section 13 conditions
grid_start_conditions: Route P nominal alpha already successful on >= 4/6 centers and a milder alpha is to be evaluated
or Route P nominal alpha close to success with predefined diagnostics indicating the limiter is lambda_min near zero, not physical-fit or numerical failure

git_policy.push_policy: local commits only; push/merge requires explicit user authorization
